appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Reservoir Surface Temperature Trend'. The plot is a single blue line with black circular markers on a white background.
Vertical axis labeled 'Surface temperature (°C)' with tick marks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20. The data line starts near the top of the plot area and descends toward the bottom-right.
Horizontal axis labeled 'Year' with tick marks for 2005 through 2015. Note the 2011 tick is absent from the label row, though the line passes through that region.
The line begins at a high point in 2005 and shows a consistent downward slope across the entire decade, ending at the lowest point in 2015. The decline is steeper between 2009-2010 and 2013-2015.
Each data point has a text label above it indicating the specific temperature value, e.g., '24.0°C' at the start and '10.0°C' at the end.

printed_facts.fact: The first data point is labeled '24.0°C'. This is the maximum value in the series.
The last data point is labeled '10.0°C'. This is the minimum value in the series.
The y-axis unit is degrees Celsius (°C). The x-axis unit is Year.
